text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume have returned. Tracen Island 
is starting to buzz with life once again.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Echoing from all across the island. Light 
footsteps... laughter and conversation, 
gentle breaths. —The sound of heartbeats.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Could this— have served as a bridge to 
instinct?

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
"I wonder if this has become a place that 
weaves your future."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Phew! That was close! But so much fuuun! I 
should've come to a place like this way 
sooner!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Umm, it went like this and then like 
that...? Ngh, focus more! Focus!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
*pant, gasp! Pant!* Ah... I really... want 
to keep running! There's plenty more in 
me!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Haha...! Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Well, well, well, everyone! Thanks for 
gathering here today!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
And... thank you so, so very much for 
everything!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With operations safely on track, the 
deserted island project was brought to a 
close for now.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
The reason we achieved such a wonderful 
result is solely because of—the fire in 
your souls! I want to thank you all once 
again!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I'm the one who should be thanking you. 
Ever since then, that girl with the braids 
has been doing great.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"A training facility so brutal it leaves 
you with no room to think—maybe that was 
exactly the place we needed when we were 
full of worries."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
From me too! Thanks so much for building 
this training facility for us!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Getting so completely absorbed in running 
that everything else faded to white... I 
was so happy.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. But it's gonna be lonely. Not coming 
here anymore, and not being able to eat 
Tucker-san's staff meals either!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, those coconuts we 
gathered together were delicious too!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
So much has happened, hasn't it? Even 
though it was only three years.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
This Chiyo-notebook is packed with maxims 
too! Like, "Tracen Island is a creature 
born from passion and raised on dreams!" 
and such!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. This place got super popular, 
huh?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Who knows, maybe one day we'll end up 
becoming true rivals at Tracen Academy."

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Dahaha! Whoa there, it's not that simple!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, I suppose you're right. All 
things must change and evolve. That is how 
living creatures have survived."

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
If it is for the sake of letting Umamusume 
run vigorously and powerfully, we must 
never stop evolving.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
If, in the midst of changing times, 
usurping Tracen Academy's role proves to 
be the best path—

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: I am not averse to it!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
...Which sounds completely ridiculous, of 
course.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for supporting my dream. Thank 
you for letting me dream even bigger 
dreams.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
—I'm still gonna keep pushing forward! So 
you guys keep running on pure instinct 
too!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: And so... FAREWELL TO THEE!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The deserted island project reached a 
grand finale, bringing down the curtain.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, some time later... on a balmy, 
pleasant afternoon.

text_block_list.name: Passing Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Was this poster always here? What's 
this, deserted island...—Recruiting 
participants for round 2?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tucker Brine's challenge doesn't seem 
likely to end anytime soon.
